statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was derived by summing two line items from the cash flow statement: 'Net increase in depreciation, amortization and provisions' and 'Depreciation of right-of-use assets'. This is a standard practice to capture total depreciation and amortization expense added back in the operating section. The 'Other adjustments and computed expenses' line was not included as it is not a direct depreciation/amortization figure.
